scope: current SmartDoc DOCX to WPS rich roundtrip fidelity smoke

notes: Old Tk and old PySide6 do not have a successful DOCX to WPS artifact baseline.
This fixture extends the current-only DOCX to WPS quality policy beyond heading/body/table into focused rich DOCX semantics.
It proves selected bold/italic runs, header/footer text, an embedded image relationship, and table text after DOCX to WPS to DOCX roundtrip; it is not a full WPS application fidelity matrix.

paragraphs: Styled run check: bold word and italic word.
Plain body paragraph survives the roundtrip.

step1_docx_to_wps.entry: uv run docwen run smart-doc-wps-rich.docx --to wps --output <dir> --json

step2_wps_to_docx.entry: uv run docwen run smart-doc-wps-rich.wps --to docx --output <dir> --json
paragraphs: Styled run check: bold word and italic word.
Plain body paragraph survives the roundtrip.

focused_acceptance: DOCX to WPS must produce a non-empty OLE compound-file output with .wps extension.
The produced WPS must be accepted by the current WPS to DOCX route.
The roundtripped DOCX must preserve the focused heading, body paragraph, bold run, italic run, table text, header text, footer text, and one embedded image part.
accepted_limits: Byte equality is not required for the generated WPS or roundtripped DOCX because Office/WPS metadata is environment-specific.
This policy still does not prove comments, fields, revisions, track changes, complex section layout, application-specific WPS behavior, or a broad old-system artifact matrix.

pre_fix_observation.cleanup_action: terminated the WPS processes started during the rich roundtrip probe

fix.summary: COM cleanup now snapshots target Office/WPS processes before DispatchEx/Dispatch and terminates only new PIDs that remain after Quit, including Dispatch fallback when a PID is unavailable.
